tagline: Turn GitHub issues and PRs into Todoist tasks automatically
metaTitle: GitHub Todoist Integration: Issues and PR Reviews as Tasks
metaDescription: Turn assigned GitHub issues and PR review requests into Todoist tasks that close when the work is done. GAIA sends a daily GitHub digest. See the setup steps.
keywords: create Todoist tasks from GitHub issues
intro:
Developers often juggle GitHub issues and pull requests alongside personal tasks in Todoist, but the two systems never talk to each other. An issue gets assigned, but it never makes it onto your today list. A PR review sits waiting while you work through a task board that has no awareness of your code queue. The result is context-switching overhead and work falling through the cracks between two separate workflows.

GAIA links them so your development work and personal task management stay aligned. When an issue is assigned to you or a PR requests your review, GAIA can automatically create a corresponding task with the right project, priority, and due date. When you close the issue or merge the PR, GAIA marks the task complete so your list stays clean without manual updates.

This is especially useful for solo developers and small teams who rely on Todoist for personal productivity but live in GitHub for actual development. Instead of maintaining two separate to-do systems, you get a single inbox that reflects everything on your plate — code work included.

useCases.title: Auto-create tasks from assigned GitHub issues
useCases.description: Whenever an issue is assigned to you, GAIA creates a matching task in your developer project with the issue title, a link back to the issue, and a due date derived from any milestone attached to it.

useCases.title: Add PR review requests to your Todoist inbox
useCases.description: When a teammate requests your review on a pull request, GAIA adds a high-priority task so code reviews never get buried under other notifications. The task includes the PR title, author, and direct link.

useCases.title: Close tasks when issues are resolved
useCases.description: GAIA watches for issue closures and PR merges, then automatically marks the corresponding tasks complete. Your task list reflects the real state of your work without any manual cleanup.

useCases.title: Daily GitHub digest as a Todoist task
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA creates a single task summarizing your open issues, pending reviews, and unresolved PR comments so you start the day with a clear picture of what needs attention in code.

useCases.title: Milestone deadline reminders
useCases.description: GAIA monitors milestone due dates and creates reminder tasks several days before deadlines so you can plan your development sprint without having to check project boards manually.

howItWorks.step: Connect GitHub and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your GitHub account and Todoist workspace in GAIA's integration settings using OAuth. GAIA only requests the permissions it needs: repository read access and task write access, respectively.
Tell GAIA which repositories to watch, which project should receive the tasks, how to map issue labels to task priorities, and when due dates should be set. Natural language rules work here.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps both systems in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: From that point on, GAIA monitors repository events in real time and updates the task list accordingly. You can also ask GAIA conversationally to create, update, or close tasks across both tools at any time.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync tasks from multiple repositories into Todoist?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can connect multiple repositories to a single GAIA workspace and route tasks from each into the same or different projects. You can also filter by repository, label, or assignee so only relevant issues become tasks.

faqs.question: What happens to a task if the issue is reopened?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect issue reopens and either recreate the task or reopen it if that state is supported, depending on your preferences. You can configure GAIA to notify you instead of taking automatic action if you prefer manual control.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with GitHub Projects as well as issues?
faqs.answer: GAIA primarily syncs issues and pull requests. Project columns and card status can inform task creation logic, but full bi-directional Projects sync is handled through GAIA's broader project management integrations.
